nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So just concentrate on things like that!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You know what? Kimi's right! I think we can do this, guys!
The Wirewolves take the stage and start to give their best performance. Before long...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Good Sir Dex, why do you continue to fight, even when the evil Kitty Pride gains strength?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I have sworn my allegiance to the House of Kimi, and I will not yield!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Then you have my sword!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: And my bow!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: And my axe!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then mount your mighty steed, my knights, and go forth into battle!
Erik rears up his 'hooves'...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Neigh! Neigh!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `Onward! To glory!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Onward! To glory![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Andrew rises from his seat, applauding heartily!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Wonderful! A rousing rendition of a classic adventurer's tale!
The Wirewolves bow graciously.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thank you, Lord Andronicus! You honor us!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Then step forward and receive a `token` of that honor.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then step forward and receive a [color=#e23b3b][i]token[/i][/color] of that honor.

nodes.text: Kimi approaches Andrew and kneels as he raises the cone-topped scepter.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I, Lord Andronicus, Scriptslayer and Lord Commander of the Manga Club, hereby grant the Cone of Theatrica to the House of Wirewolves!
He presents Kimi with the cone! She stands and raises it high above her head as her teammates cheer!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Awesome! You're the greatest, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, way to pull us all together! We'll catch up to the other teams in no time!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Neigh! Neigh!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: So what's next for us?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think we should keep moving. Maybe split up?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Good idea. I'll take some people to try for the cafeteria cone.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ...I'm also pretty hungry.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll go ahead to the swimming pool cone. Meet me there this afternoon!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Anyway, all we can do now is hope we made a good enough impression to get an invitation.
Later, the Platypi meander around the party, when they spot Carson and his friends lounging in the VIP area.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Hey! There they are! The Platypi!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey Carson!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I've been asking around, and everyone's talking about you guys! Seems like you're the life of the party!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Why don't you come and join us in the VIP section!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We'd love to! Does this mean we earned the cone?
He makes an opening for them in the velvet rope, and the four of them hurry in.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: S'all yours!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Awesome!
As the boys plop down on the couch, Emily scoops up the cone from the table!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yes! We're on our way to catching up with Kitty Pride! We just need a few more cones!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You mean... We're not gonna stay for the party?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: There's no time! We're still behind Kitty Pride. We need to catch up!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Fine...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We'll split up! You guys stop by the cafeteria challenge, I'm going for the swimming pool cone. Meet me there this afternoon!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey Carson!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oh, hey guys...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Um... Any chance we could join you in the VIP section?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Well, about that... I've been asking around, and I'm not sure the party atmosphere is gelling quite right...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: It means you're weirding some people out. I'm gonna have to ask you to leave.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But--
The bouncer herds you towards the door, scooting you across the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, `this` was a bust...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] was a bust...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Worst. Party. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What do we do now? We're one cone down, which means we're still behind Kitty Pride. We've practically handed them the lead.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We can't get discouraged. We'll split up and try for more challenges around campus. I'm going for the swimming pool cone. Meet me there this afternoon!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Chris, you and Carson both love throwing parties! You should talk about that!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I'll give it a shot...
Chris stops Carson as he makes his way across the floor...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Hey, Carson! Just wanted to say the party's awesome so far.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: The subwoofer really makes a difference with your stereo setup! And arranging snack tables like a buffet line? Genius!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Looks like you know a thing or two about throwing parties!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Yeah, I picked up some pointers from Hector. But I'm always open to learn more!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Hector's parties were legendary! You've got big shoes to fill, my man.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: But I'm always stoked to meet fellow party enthusiasts! Maybe we can talk shop later!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Awesome! That'd be great!
Carson gives a wave and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Good job, Chris!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You have stuff in common with Carson, right?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well... You like telling your eyepatch stories... And Carson likes hearing stories...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: He does?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, I assume so. Who doesn't?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Kind of a stretch, but I'll give it a shot.
Andy stops Carson as he makes his way across the floor...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Hey, Carson. Have I ever told you the story behind my eyepatch?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Um... What?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You like parties, don't you? Well, I've been to a few parties in my day...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: One of them was a `fencing` party. Sure, it was all fun and games, until--
nodes.text_bbcode: One of them was a [color=#e23b3b][i]fencing[/i][/color] party. Sure, it was all fun and games, until--

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: ...Someone put an eye out?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Huh? `No!` Until someone dared me to look at the sun through a telescope!
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh? [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color] Until someone dared me to look at the sun through a telescope!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Why would you do that?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Because I never back down from a challenge!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Anyway, a solar flare occurred at just the right moment, with enough UV radiation to scar my retina--

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: All right, I think I've heard enough! I've gotta go, uh... Check something. Over there.
Carson hurries away, flustered.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Maybe eyepatch stories weren't the best way to get on his good side.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I could have sworn that would work...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Um... Andy?

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Well, what now?
Emily notices Carson making his way back across the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Now we go straight to the man himself.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What, we just walk up and ask for an invitation?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No, we should socialize and be friendly. And send someone who has something in common with him, like...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ryan has the most experience talking to girls. Maybe he should do the talking.
The team walks up to the girls, with Ryan taking the lead...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hello, `ladies...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hello, [color=#e23b3b][i]ladies...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Hey, Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Is it just me, or is this music a little too loud?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Heh, yeah I guess it is pretty excessive.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: How's anyone supposed to hear themselves `making out` in here, am I right?
nodes.text_bbcode: How's anyone supposed to hear themselves [color=#e23b3b][i]making out[/i][/color] in here, am I right?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ugh! Gross!
Taken aback, the girls turn to leave!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: W... Wait! You've got me all wrong!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah! When I said 'anyone', I specifically meant `me and you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! When I said 'anyone', I specifically meant [color=#e23b3b][i]me and you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `UGH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]UGH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The girls storm off!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Geez, what was her problem?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Remind me never to ask you for a favor when girls are involved.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ladies love the eyepatch!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What? You're sending Cyclops? You know I can kiss... er, `talk` better than him!
nodes.text_bbcode: What? You're sending Cyclops? You know I can kiss... er, [color=#e23b3b][i]talk[/i][/color] better than him!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, now there's no `way` I'm letting you do the talking.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, now there's no [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] I'm letting you do the talking.

nodes.text: The team walks up to the girls, with Andy taking the lead...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hey, Andy. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Nothing much. I was just telling my friends the story of how I got this eyepatch...
Minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I knew a swimming race in the Amazon River would be challenging, but I had no idea what the real cost would be.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Now, I can fend off a piranha... Heck, I can fend off a dozen piranhas!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: But not a `baker's dozen...` Never a baker's dozen...
nodes.text_bbcode: But not a [color=#e23b3b][i]baker's dozen...[/i][/color] Never a baker's dozen...

nodes.text: Andy touches his eyepatch and looks wistfully off into the distance...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Someday, I'll have my revenge on that thirteenth fish...

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: What an `awesome` story! Do you have any more to tell?
nodes.text_bbcode: What an [color=#3b78e2][i]awesome[/i][/color] story! Do you have any more to tell?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Definitely.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Cool. We're gonna hang out in the VIP lounge later. You all should join us!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Love to. We'd need an invite though.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh! I'll talk to Carson and see what we can do!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Great!
The girls and the Platypi part ways.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Good job, Andy!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh... I guess, Ryan?
Soon after, the party's host arrives! `Carson` saunters through the crowded dance floor, greeting guests and shaking hands as he approaches Emily and her teammates.
nodes.text_bbcode: Soon after, the party's host arrives! [b]Carson[/b] saunters through the crowded dance floor, greeting guests and shaking hands as he approaches Emily and her teammates.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Hey! If it isn't...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Uh, who are you guys supposed to be again? The Potato Pies?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: The Platypi. As in the plural for 'platypus'.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Wait a minute... Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: What do you mean, 'who am I'? I'm Carson! Notorious party guy!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Sorry, never heard of you...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Huh. Guess I `have` been M.I.A. for a while...
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh. Guess I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] been M.I.A. for a while...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: In any case, I'm back and in full effect! Mr. Bernstein told me about the little game you guys are playing.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: He's the one who agreed to let me throw a party on school property! All I had to do was promise to look after some safety cone thing. Crazy, right?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So you `do` have the cone! We actually need it for our project...
nodes.text_bbcode: So you [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] have the cone! We actually need it for our project...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oof, sorry. Bernstein said to keep it safe, so I put it in the safest place of all... `The VIP section!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oof, sorry. Bernstein said to keep it safe, so I put it in the safest place of all... [color=#e23b3b][i]The VIP section![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He motions to a roped-off area in the corner of the gym, where a few students lounge on lavish couches. In between them, among snacks and drinks, sits the orange cone!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Unfortunately, it's exclusively for our most high-profile party-goers. Invites only.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: So feel free to stay and mingle! But if you want that cone, you'll have to impress my guests and be the life of the party!
Carson turns and shouts an excited greeting to someone across the dance floor before he walks off.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ugh. 'Invites only'?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: So where do we start?
Emily looks over to a group of girls hanging out on the edge of the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How about with them?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Heheh, perfect...` I've been raring to get my groove on with some ladies...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Maybe don't say 'get my groove on' anymore. It comes off as creepy when you say it...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: ...Or when you say `anything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Or when you say [color=#e23b3b][i]anything.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Creepy, huh? Look who's talking, Cyclops.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Hey, chicks dig the patch 'a lot' more than a backwards hat!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: If it's a group of girls, I think we should leave this to...

nodes.prompt: Who should talk to the girls?

menu.title: Hurry!
menu.text: Who should talk to the girls?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're the party expert! Go, you know, schmooze with him!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Schmooze? But... But...
Emily pushes Chris forward as the bouncer makes his way out of the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Hey, um... Excuse me... Fella...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Sorry. You scrubs gotta leave.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I, uh...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You got a problem?

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: No! I mean, yes! But not with you!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: The problem is the cones... And that we need one...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Right! Of course! Sorry to bother you! Bye!
Chris sheepishly bows his head and turns away. The rest of the group follows suit.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Chris! What was that?

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I don't do well with tough-guy types. I'm like a red-headed bullseye to them!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah, I could've told you that! Should've left the tough guy to a tough guy! Let me handle this!
Ryan steps forward to meet the bouncer, whose face lights up with recognition.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Oh! Sup, Ryan? Didn't recognize you for a second.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Likewise. What's the deal with this party?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Got a paid gig, letting only cool kids into `Carson's` party. He wants me to boot any losers.
nodes.text_bbcode: Got a paid gig, letting only cool kids into [color=#e23b3b][i]Carson's[/i][/color] party. He wants me to boot any losers.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: No offense, but I was about to kick these guys out, til I realized you were with them.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What about letting us slide, for old times sake?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Sure thing, man. But be careful in there, Carson's been pretty picky about his guests... And you're not really rolling with the coolest of crowds.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Hey!
Travis steps aside and lets the team wander further into the gym.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: He looks like he might be... You know, your type.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What? Just because it's some sketchy looking guy, you assume he's someone I know? Not every--

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Oh hey, it's Travis!
Ryan steps forward to meet the bouncer, whose face lights up with recognition.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Sup, Ryan?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Not much man. What's the deal with all this?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Not really my crowd.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, you and me both.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: But I got a paid gig, letting only cool kids into `Carson's` party. He wants me to boot any losers.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I got a paid gig, letting only cool kids into [color=#e23b3b][i]Carson's[/i][/color] party. He wants me to boot any losers.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Yeah, I was about to kick you and your friends out, till I realized it was you.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What about letting us slide, for old times' sake?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Sure thing, man. Carson's been pretty picky about his guests, but I'll put in a good word for you.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Awesome.
Travis steps aside and lets the Platypi in!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Way to go, Ryan! Guess my call was right!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yup! Hang with me, and you'll go places.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Um... Chris! You should do it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So just, you know... Concentrate on things like that.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But, you just started spouting off nonsense!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Some of those weren't even words...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I feel less prepared than before...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, just do your best I guess?
The Wirewolves reluctantly take the stage and start to give the best performance they can, but before long...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Good Sir Dex, why do you continue to--

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You have my bow!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Kevin, that's `my` cue, not yours! Wait for Brendan to say, 'Then you have m--'
nodes.text_bbcode: Kevin, that's [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] cue, not yours! Wait for Brendan to say, 'Then you have m--'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `THEN YOU HAVE MY SWORD!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]THEN YOU HAVE MY SWORD![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Why are you shouting?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I was in the moment! He has my sword!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Guys! Let's focus!
Erik prances around them, rearing his imaginary hooves.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I am the horse!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Stop! Stop!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What in the world is this... This `travesty?` It's a mockery to the world of theatre!
nodes.text_bbcode: What in the world is this... This [color=#e23b3b][i]travesty?[/i][/color] It's a mockery to the world of theatre!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, I admit it's a little rough.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It was my prancing, wasn't it? I wasn't being horsey enough!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Forsooth. It was a lot of things.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Now remove yourselves from my stage! You are unworthy of the cone!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But--

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Begone! Lord Andronicus demands it!
The team leaves the auditorium, defeated.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Well, `that` didn't go well.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] didn't go well.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We still have a chance to turn it all around and catch up with the other teams! Let's split up and each go after different cones!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Sounds like as sound a plan as any.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm going after the cone at the pool. Meet up with me there this afternoon!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Unfortunately, Mr. Bernstein entrusted me to give this cone to only the most worthy adventurers!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: In return, the drama department will receive access to the stage for extra rehearsal time!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And how do we prove ourselves 'worthy' of the cone?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Why, you must prove yourself on the battlefield of bards and mummers!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `...Egypt?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...Egypt?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Not mummies, `mummers.` He means actors.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not mummies, [color=#3b78e2][i]mummers.[/i][/color] He means actors.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Indeed! As a group, you must perform a skit fit to entertain royalty. Succeed, and the cone is yours!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You have `three minutes` to impress me!
nodes.text_bbcode: You have [color=#e23b3b][i]three minutes[/i][/color] to impress me!

nodes.text: The Wirewolves turn and squeeze into a group huddle.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah, we're nerds, not spontaneous performers!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But lots of your hobbies have to do with `storytelling,` right?
nodes.text_bbcode: But lots of your hobbies have to do with [color=#3b78e2][i]storytelling,[/i][/color] right?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: True... Tabletop games like `Ogres 'N' Elves` take imagination.
nodes.text_bbcode: True... Tabletop games like [color=#e23b3b][i]Ogres 'N' Elves[/i][/color] take imagination.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, all `roleplaying games` involve creating characters' backstories!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, all [color=#e23b3b][i]roleplaying games[/i][/color] involve creating characters' backstories!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Don't forget Live-action roleplaying! `LARPing` takes tons of creativity!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't forget Live-action roleplaying! [color=#e23b3b][i]LARPing[/i][/color] takes tons of creativity!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: See? We can do this, guys! Just focus on those hobbies, and we'll get ourselves in the zone! Things like...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Unclassifiable?` Like some manner of oddity?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Unclassifiable?[/i][/color] Like some manner of oddity?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: N... No! I just meant, you don't fit in either category because you combine the best qualities of both!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hmm. Your attempts to appease me are obvious and transparent... But appreciated.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The intellect of a nerd, plus the charisma and showmanship of a thespian!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Verily, you speak the truth m'lady. Would that I could grant you this cone in gratitude for your kind words...
Maria makes a mad dash for the end of the field! The other cheerleaders rush to catch up as the horde of football players stampedes after her!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're not getting away that easy!
Spencer makes one last sprint...
...But Maria is too far away!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hff... Hff... Wait!
She darts off the field, leaving the football players panting and exhausted!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: See ya!
Later, the Kitty Pride teammates regroup with Maria.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: That was awesome, Maria! Way to keep our lead!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah! What next?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We keep moving. On to the cafeteria, and then to the swimming pool. Nothing's gonna stop us from winning this competition!
...And catches Maria! He scoops her up in his arms with ease!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Drop. The. Cone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Drop. The. Cone.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hmph. Fine.
Later, the Kitty Pride teammates regroup with Maria.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, we didn't get the cone... But we tried our best.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't want to `try` our best. I want to `be` the best! Every cone we don't get affects our lead!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't want to [color=#3b78e2][i]try[/i][/color] our best. I want to [color=#3b78e2][i]be[/i][/color] the best! Every cone we don't get affects our lead!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So what do we do?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Now, we keep moving. On to the cafeteria, and then to the swimming pool. Nothing's gonna stop us from winning this competition!
You are now playing as Kimi.
Kimi and the rest of the Wirewolves arrive in the auditorium and wander onto the stage, which seems to be deserted except for a lone spotlight.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Well, this is... Weird. The map says the auditorium has a cone challenge, but it doesn't look like anyone's here.
Suddenly, a voice calls out from somewhere in the darkened auditorium seats!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Ho! Who dares enter the realm of Theatrica?
The Wirewolves let out a collective groan. Dex leans over to the group.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Oh no... If I know Andrew, he's not going to make this easy for us. He gets super into competitions like this!
Kimi turns back to Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Andrew, we really need that cone... Think you could help us out?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: 'Andrew'? You are addressing Lord Andronicus, First of his Name, King of the Drama Geeks and `Warden of the Cone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Andrew'? You are addressing Lord Andronicus, First of his Name, King of the Drama Geeks and [color=#e23b3b][i]Warden of the Cone![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He raises a makeshift scepter, made with one of Mr. Bernstein's cones placed atop a broom handle!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Can't you just give it to us? You're supposed to be on `our` side.
nodes.text_bbcode: Can't you just give it to us? You're supposed to be on [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] side.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Your 'side'? Lord Andronicus has sworn no allegiances!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well... You're a drama geek, but also a nerd! A hybrid!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah! Like a halfling who is part human, part elf!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Or a mule! Part horse, part nerd!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hmph. What is your meaning? Dost thou think me `strange?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmph. What is your meaning? Dost thou think me [color=#e23b3b][i]strange?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Um... Of course not! Apologies, m'lord!
Ashley whispers to the rest of the team.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: We have to play to Andrew's ego!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Right... Um, Andrew, what we meant was...

options.label: You're the best of both worlds!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hup!
Maria flips into a one-handed cartwheel, cradling the cone with her free hand as she effortlessly avoids Jacob's grab for her ankle!
She continues on without skipping a beat!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Sorry! Too slow!
Maria sinks into a perfect split...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ta-da!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Wait... Why am I doing this?
Jacob grabs her ankle!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Give back the cone!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ack! Let go!
Struggling, Maria awkwardly kicks free and stumbles away!
Maria freezes up...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Um...
Maria runs for the endzone, when suddenly...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh no you don't!
Jacob dives at Maria's feet, trying to trip her up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Wuh oh...
Maria leans back...
...And bumps right into Phil!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Ah!
She stumbles to the grass! Phil reaches down and tries to snatch the cone from her hand, but she just barely manages to scramble to her feet and escape!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hnng!
Maria dives forward, just eluding Phil's grasp! He grabs empty air and topples to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Can't catch me!
Panicking, Maria backpedals...
Maria continues on her way, when she suddenly notices someone charging at her from behind!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Maria, look out!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hrrah!
Maria places her foot in Keith's hands and jumps as he lifts...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ha!
...Vaulting her into the air in a perfect toss! She sails over the wall of oncoming football players!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa!
...And lands gracefully on the other side!
Maria panics and stumbles right into Keith!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oof!
They both topple down onto the grass!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What was `that?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What was [color=#e23b3b][i]that?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Never mind that... Just help me up!
The football players close in on Maria as she struggles to get up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Got it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Let's get out of here!
Maria turns and bolts!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stop her!
The football players turn in Maria's direction! A wall of linebackers charges at her!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh oh!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Maria, over here! I'll give you a boost!
Keith laces his fingers together, making a step with his hands! Maria runs toward him and...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Everyone, follow my lead. Nicole, hit the music!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Right!
Nicole pulls out a stereo and cues a track.
The cheerleaders saunter onto the field and fall into position...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Huh? What's going on?
As the music starts, the cheerleaders jump into their most risque dance routine!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Shake it, girls!
The shimmying and gyrating continues until...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Um... What the heck are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You just started dancing at us out of nowhere. Is this supposed to distract me or something?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Give us a `little` bit of credit!
nodes.text_bbcode: Give us a [color=#e23b3b][i]little[/i][/color] bit of credit!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah, that was hot... But we're not `that` dumb!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, that was hot... But we're not [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] dumb!

nodes.text: Spencer holds the cone a little tighter.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But... We haven't even gotten to the human pyramid yet!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Huh? But there's no pyramid in this routine!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `Pyramid! NOW!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Pyramid! NOW![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Eek! Okay!
The girls panic into a rushed, awkward dog pile on top of Keith!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Mmmf! ...This was `not` what we rehearsed!
nodes.text_bbcode: Mmmf! ...This was [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] what we rehearsed!

nodes.text: Soon, the sloppy pyramid comes collapsing down to the grass!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa! Are you guys okay?
Concerned, Spencer approaches, momentarily distracted...
...When Maria snatches the cone!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Trust me. Once we turn on the charm, they won't be thinking about the cone!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I think I like this plan.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Wait a minute... What am `I` supposed to do?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a minute... What am [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Just do your best, Keith.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Um... Okay...
The cheerleaders saunter over to the football players.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, boys. Looking good on that field.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: But we haven't even started playing yet.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: ...I wasn't talking about football.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Your hair looks awesome today, Jacob!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Heh, really? Well, thanks! I decided to actually comb it this morning...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, Jacob... It's really... Nice?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh... Thanks, Keith. I guess.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: It's `sooo` cool that Bernstein trusted you with the cone. It's probably 'cause of how strong and commanding you are.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]sooo[/i][/color] cool that Bernstein trusted you with the cone. It's probably 'cause of how strong and commanding you are.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Mmhmm. That's what all the girls are saying anyway...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, I `am` pretty strong. Been doing a lot of lifting...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] pretty strong. Been doing a lot of lifting...

nodes.text: Spencer lifts up the cone in a bicep curl, showing off his muscle...
...When Maria snatches it out of his hand!
Score Up!
Mr. Bernstein turns, reaches for the top of the blackboard, and unfurls a wide, yellowed parchment...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What is this?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: This is my map of the `realms of Twin Branches!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is my map of the [color=#e23b3b][i]realms of Twin Branches![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Everyone stares at the ancient-looking map of what appears to be the school campus!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why is everything all divided up into pieces?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: It relates to the rest of the project, and how your teams will be competing...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Solving jigsaw puzzles! The sport of kings!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: That's... Incorrect.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Over the next few weeks, the competition is going beyond the classroom! I've divided the campus into numerous realms.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Each one has a cone that any team can claim... But to do so, they must successfully complete a challenge!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And who's running these challenges?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Oh, I've enlisted some kind student volunteers to help. There are lots of cones to win, so it's anyone's game!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Remember, the team that wins this competition gets the `last week of summer school off!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Remember, the team that wins this competition gets the [color=#e23b3b][i]last week of summer school off![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Ugh. Kitty Pride `so` needs to win that prize! I haven't been to `one` pool party this summer! I'm having withdrawals.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. Kitty Pride [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] needs to win that prize! I haven't been to [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] pool party this summer! I'm having withdrawals.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Imagine, a whole week of tabletop games with `no one` telling me to go out into the sunlight! Could there be a greater prize?
nodes.text_bbcode: Imagine, a whole week of tabletop games with [color=#e23b3b][i]no one[/i][/color] telling me to go out into the sunlight! Could there be a greater prize?

nodes.text: Excited, the students get up from their seats and prepare to disperse. Kimi leans over to Emily.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, maybe we'll see you out there?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah... Good luck?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Now go forth! Battle for conquest! The game is afoot! `Anything goes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now go forth! Battle for conquest! The game is afoot! [color=#e23b3b][i]Anything goes![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You are now playing as Maria.
Maria leads the rest of the Kitty Pride team onto the football field.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: All right, everyone. We're already in the lead, so let's just collect these cones and get this over with.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: There's supposed to be one out here...
The cheerleaders scan the field, where the football team is milling about, preparing for a practice session.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Over there! Spencer's got it!
Maria looks to the middle of the field, where Spencer stands amidst Phil, Jacob, and the rest of the football team. He holds an orange cone, tossing it from hand to hand!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Wait here.
Maria leaves her teammates behind as she walks over to Spencer and his friends.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey Spencer. Looks like Mr. Bernstein gave you one of those orange cones.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yup. Bernstein says if I protect this cone with some kinda challenge, he'll get us access to this field even after dark.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah! Then we could have night practices!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Do you know how epic that would be?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, I don't. And I don't care. Just give us the cone!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sorry, Maria. Rules is rules. You can't have the cone unless you beat us at `football.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, Maria. Rules is rules. You can't have the cone unless you beat us at [color=#e23b3b][i]football.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ugh!
Maria storms off, back to her waiting teammates.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Spencer's really playing along with this challenge stuff. And the challenge he chose is football. Surprise, surprise.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But we can't beat them at football! That's all they `do!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But we can't beat them at football! That's all they [color=#3b78e2][i]do![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Duh. But we don't have to beat them. All we have to do is distract them, then snatch the cone and run!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Isn't that... Cheating?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You heard what Bernstein said. `'Anything goes'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You heard what Bernstein said. [color=#3b78e2][i]'Anything goes'.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Okay then... How do we distract them?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: All we have to do is...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You know... 'Cause it was the Dark Ages... And everything was super scary?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: What? No!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: ...Well, I suppose it `was` a tumultuous period of history, relatively speaking...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Well, I suppose it [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] a tumultuous period of history, relatively speaking...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: But that's not the point! What I said earlier was that medieval conflicts were about `territory!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But that's not the point! What I said earlier was that medieval conflicts were about [color=#e23b3b][i]territory![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Which brings me to my next point...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It was different factions fighting over conquered lands.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Correct! Which actually brings me to my next point...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You know... 'Cause small dogs were very popular back then. Everyone had one in their portraits...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: What? No!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: ...Well, I suppose lapdogs `were` common among royalty...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Well, I suppose lapdogs [color=#e23b3b][i]were[/i][/color] common among royalty...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: But that's not the point! What I said earlier was that medieval conflicts were about `territory!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But that's not the point! What I said earlier was that medieval conflicts were about [color=#e23b3b][i]territory![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Which brings me to my next point...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: About... Um... Orange cones?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Although I see where your confusion comes from.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: What I said earlier was that medieval conflicts were about `territory!`

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Which brings me to my next point...
And now...

nodes.text: Whew! It's nice to be back!

nodes.text: Even though Lindsay's still mean to me, she's got nothing on the people at my new school!

nodes.text: Kimi's hands grasp the edge of the ledge! She pulls herself up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yes!
Using the key, Kimi opens the locker and pulls out the cone!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I got it!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Um... You mean `'we'` got it, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Um... You mean [color=#3b78e2][i]'we'[/i][/color] got it, right?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Congratulations! Now, `to the winner go the spoils...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Congratulations! Now, [color=#e23b3b][i]to the winner go the spoils...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Well, you won using teamwork... So which team gets the cone?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We'll figure that out later, Kimi! Now throw me the cone and lower yourself down!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You'll have to make a decision eventually, Kimi. It's not like you can just `fly out the window...`
nodes.text_bbcode: You'll have to make a decision eventually, Kimi. It's not like you can just [color=#e23b3b][i]fly out the window...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Just then, a ruckus sounds from outside! Kimi turns back to the window and notices that it's `open!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just then, a ruckus sounds from outside! Kimi turns back to the window and notices that it's [b]open![/b]

nodes.text: Kimi looks out the window to see scattered groups of students approaching.
Her teammates, the Wirewolves approach... But with the Platypi and Kitty Pride close behind!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Look! It's Kimi! What's she doing in the window?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did someone put her on sale?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, look! She's got the cone! Way to go!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Awesome! This'll put the Wirewolves back in the running!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hey Kimi! Just climb out onto the awning! It's just a short drop to the grass from there!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Our teammates are on their way!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kimi, come on! If you're so worried about the cone, just leave the Wirewolves and join the Platypi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well... You could also leave `your` team and join `mine...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... You could also leave [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] team and join [color=#3b78e2][i]mine...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Stop joking around, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That wasn't a joke! I have other friends now, too! And not only do they need me, they appreciate me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Why is it always `me` that has to make the sacrifice for `you?` Why am I the one who has to work around your swim schedule or the one who has to switch teams?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why is it always [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] that has to make the sacrifice for [color=#3b78e2][i]you?[/i][/color] Why am I the one who has to work around your swim schedule or the one who has to switch teams?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, I `thought` it was because you were a loyal friend, but maybe I was wrong!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I [color=#3b78e2][i]thought[/i][/color] it was because you were a loyal friend, but maybe I was wrong!

nodes.text: Kimi grits her teeth, a knot turning in the pit of her stomach...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, I `am` a loyal friend...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] a loyal friend...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...To the `Wirewolves!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...To the [color=#3b78e2][i]Wirewolves![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Kimi crawls out through the open window with the cone!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kimi! Come back here!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...I knew I should've brought popcorn.
Outside, Kimi shimmies to the edge of the awning of the aquatic center, hangs over the edge, and hops down to the bushes below. Her teammates greet her with excitement!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well met, Lady Kimi! We'll conquer these realms in no time!
The other teams point at them and shout!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: It's the Wirewolves!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ugh! Those nerds got another cone?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What now?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: On to the next cone! The Wirewolves are going to win this...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...No matter `who` gets in our way!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...No matter [color=#3b78e2][i]who[/i][/color] gets in our way!

nodes.text: You have reached the end of `Season 7, Episode 6: Game of Cones!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 7, Episode 6: Game of Cones![/b]

nodes.text: Before we tally your score, a few messages...
Want to catch up? `A New Start 6: The Talent Show` is now available in More Episodes!

nodes.text: And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!

Kimi loses her footing! Emily stumbles trying to recover, but they both topple backward into the pool!
`SPLASH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SPLASH![/b]

nodes.text: The two plunge beneath the surface before coming up, sputtering!

Mr. Bernstein stands by his parchment map of Twin Branches High, nodding with admiration.
Ms. Lee walks in through the door behind him.
Mr. Bernstein, what's the meaning of this?
The campus has been in a state of chaos all day! This is supposed to be summer school! It should be tedious and soul-sucking!
The chess club turned the cafeteria into a life-size game board! The auto-shop students are jousting on go-carts!
The Home Ec class sewed a dragon costume for the school mascot.
...That part actually is an improvement. We should make that permanent.
But all of the other stuff is just inappropriate!
On the contrary! It's exactly how I envisioned a modern recreation of medieval turmoil!
Just then, Wes walks in, a smug smile on his face.

I can't tell if you're joking, and I don't like it. `Hmph!`

The deed is done. Kimi ended up with the cone.
Ah. So the Wirewolves have conquered the pool. Interesting.

Practice time on the tennis courts? Some laminated hall passes? Unlimited drinking fountain privilege?
Oh, no need to worry about that. Tell you what, I'll settle for a rain check.
When I happen to need that favor you `owe me,` I'll stop on by and let you know how you can help. Sound like a deal?
I, uh... Well, I'm afraid that depends on what the favor--
I was `just` telling everyone about how honorable Mr. Bernstein is. Always a man of his word...
Well, I suppose I am, but--

Excellent. Always a pleasure doing business, Mr. B. See ya soon!
Wes gives a casual salute as he turns and strides out of the room!
...Why do I feel like I just made a deal with the devil?
